title: Peptide Mass Spec Sample Preparation
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck hardware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the Opentrons deck: Slot 1 – Nunc 96‑well polystyrene V‑bottom plate; Slot 2 – NEST 0.1 mL 96‑well PCR plate (full skirt); Slot 3 – NEST 12‑well 15 mL reservoir; Slot 4 – Opentrons Magnetic Module GEN2 with a 1.2 mL Stellar Scientific Cluster Tube rack on the module; Slot 5 and Slot 8 – Opentrons 300 µL tip rack; Slot 6 and Slot 9 – Opentrons 20 µL tip rack. Set the magnetic‑module engage height to 13.5 mm (distance from well bottom). Note: when the protocol reaches the pause step, swap the Cluster Tube plate with the NEST PCR plate on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Configure pipettes and parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, specify the mount side for the P20 and P300 multi‑channel pipettes, set the number of samples (maximum 48), define the aspiration rate used for acetonitrile or supernatant, and enter the wash and supernatant transfer volumes (in µL) required for the protocol.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the Python protocol file for peptide mass‑spec sample preparation from the provided source.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Load deck map in app
steps.instruction: Select the deck layout that matches the hardware arrangement described in Step 1 and load it in the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons app to calibrate each tip rack, the PCR plate, the reservoir, and the magnetic module, following the on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons app to start the automated peptide mass‑spec sample preparation.
